tariffs_explained.description: Explains what tariffs are, with meme-infused jokes.
tariffs_explained.info: Tariffs are taxes countries slap on imports. Basically, 'Pay up if you want to sell your junk here.'
jokes: Tariffs: Because your toaster needs to be 30% more expensive to make your economy ‘great again’. 🇺🇸
Trade war? More like tax dodgeball.
Tariffs are like relationship boundaries… but with shipping containers.
Who needs diplomacy when you’ve got tariffs and Twitter beefs?
examples: Why did the chicken cross the border? It didn’t. It got hit with a 25% import tariff.
The US puts tariffs on steel. Canada puts maple syrup on pancakes. One of them is peaceful.
